name: get_game_feature_state
purpose: Enumerate every game-feature plugin with exact state-machine state (incl. error states) — machine-readable DLC registration diagnosis.
cooked: unaffected — reads state machines, not assets; today reports both DLCs ErrorRegistering (GFD assets only in cooked containers)
prevents: DLC registration failures only visible by parsing the editor log
hazards: LexToString(EGameFeaturePluginState) unexported — regenerate name table from public GAME_FEATURE_PLUGIN_STATE_LIST X-macro (GameFeatureTypes.h:9-38)
No public enumerate-all API — iterate IPluginManager::GetDiscoveredPlugins filtered by GetPluginURLByName
Zero UFUNCTIONs on subsystem (live-verified) — C++ link against GameFeatures module is the only route

name: change_game_feature_state_request
purpose: Drive a game-feature plugin to Installed/Registered/Loaded/Active; completion error code becomes machine-readable via the status pair.
cooked: transitions content-agnostic; for these DLCs Registering fails (Plugin_Missing_GameFeatureData) until content layout fixed — endpoint is how you test the fix
hazards: NEVER call engine LexFromString on raw input — no-match defaults to Count + ensureAlwaysMsgf, then check() in ChangeGameFeatureTargetState can CRASH (cpp:136-158, :855-870); pre-validate the four literal strings
Registering/Loading stalls the game thread via WaitUntilComplete(0.0f) inside state-machine tick (GameFeaturePluginStateMachine.cpp:2226, :2384) — editor may hitch for full asset load
Completion delegate can fire synchronously inside the request call (policy-refusal paths, cpp:875-900) — latch-then-return design tolerates this
targetState=Active runs GameFeatureActions; refuse while pie_status.running unless force:true
Mounts/unmounts paks, scans asset registry, runs actions — non-transactable; handler must open NO transaction

name: change_game_feature_state_status
purpose: Poll a pending game-feature state change: {pending, done, ok, errorCode, errorText, currentState, targetState} from bridge-side latch.
hazards: No retroactive error detail: FResult of transitions the bridge did not initiate (e.g. startup auto-load) is unrecoverable — only error STATE is readable

name: render_asset_thumbnail
purpose: Render a per-asset Content Browser-style thumbnail PNG so an agent can visually confirm an asset without loading a level.
engineApi: ThumbnailTools::RenderThumbnail UNREALED_API (ObjectTools.h:709); LoadThumbnailFromPackage (:740); FObjectThumbnail::GetUncompressedImageData CORE_API (ObjectThumbnail.h:164); FImageUtils::SaveImageByExtension ENGINE_API (ImageUtils.h:106)
cooked: degraded honestly — container textures/meshes/materials render; cooked BP-only assets fall back blank (report blank:true); LoadThumbnailFromPackage fallback dead for container assets (no thumbnail table)
prevents: ThumbnailGenerator plugin route is dead (SDK-dump stub DLL)
hazards: flush:"always" runs FlushAsyncLoading + shader-compile wait + StreamAllResources (ObjectTools.cpp:5076-5089) — potentially multi-minute stall; "never" default is load-bearing
Call RenderThumbnail directly, NEVER GenerateThumbnailForObjectToSaveToDisk — it opens a modal FScopedSlowTask dialog (cpp:5218-5219)
Classes without a thumbnail renderer yield blank images — detect zero-variance buffer, return blank:true with package-thumbnail fallback
